data.name: FilterFiles
data.comment: The Explorer's filter field.

data.name: SwitchView
data.value: Switch between the solution and the files on disk
data.comment: The tip of the Explorer's view switch.

data.name: SolutionView
data.comment: The Explorer's view switch while it shows the solution's projects.

data.name: FilesView
data.comment: The Explorer's view switch while it shows the folder's files on disk.

data.name: NothingOpen
data.comment: The Explorer with no folder, solution or project open.

data.name: NoFileMatches
data.comment: The Explorer's rows where its filter leaves no file.

data.name: MoreMatch
data.value: {count, plural, one {# more file matches} other {# more files match}}: a longer filter narrows them
data.comment: Under the Explorer's rows, the files its filter matched beyond those it shows.

data.name: FileNesting
data.comment: The Explorer's option opening the File Nesting dialog; without its dots, that dialog's title.

data.name: HasErrors
data.comment: What a screen reader is told of a file whose name the error's wave underlines.

data.name: Projects
data.comment: Beside a solution's name in the Explorer: how many projects it shows.

data.name: Unloaded
data.comment: Beside an unloaded project's name in the Explorer.

data.name: NoSdk
data.comment: Beside a project's name in the Explorer while the folder has no .NET SDK to read it with.

data.name: LoadFailed
data.comment: Beside a project's name in the Explorer where MSBuild could not read it.

data.name: Shared
data.comment: Beside a shared project's name in the Explorer.

data.name: WindowsOnly
data.comment: Beside a project's name in the Explorer where every framework it targets runs only on Windows; {frameworks} lists them.

data.name: SomeWindowsOnly
data.comment: Beside a project's name where some of its frameworks run only on Windows; {frameworks} lists them all, {windows} those.

data.name: WindowsOnlyTip
data.value: {why}: Passenger builds {project} here for its code help (EnableWindowsTargeting), and Run, Debug and Profile need Windows
data.comment: The tip of a project that runs only on Windows, off Windows; {why} says why it runs only there.

data.name: SharedUnimported
data.value: Shared project: no project imports {items}, so none compiles its files
data.comment: The tip of a shared project no project imports; {items} is its items file's name.

data.name: SharedImported
data.value: Shared project: its files are compiled into {projects}, which {count, plural, one {imports} other {import}} {items}
data.comment: The tip of a shared project; {projects} lists the projects importing it, {count} how many, {items} its items file's name.

data.name: Dependencies
data.comment: The row under a project listing what it references.

data.name: SourceGenerators
data.comment: The row under a project's dependencies listing its source generators.

data.name: GeneratorTip
data.comment: The tip of a source generator's row; {generator} is its type's whole name, {assembly} its assembly.

data.name: AskedVersion
data.comment: Beside a package a package brings, resolved to a newer version than asked; {asked} is the version range asked for, briefly.

data.name: AsksFor
data.comment: The tip of a package a package brings; {asked} is the version range asked for.

data.name: AsksForResolved
data.comment: The tip of a package a package brings, resolved to a newer version than asked.

data.name: Unlisted
data.value: {items} leaves it out of the shared project: Include in Project takes it in
data.comment: The tip of a file in a shared project's folder its items file leaves out; {items} is that file's name.

data.name: PackageWorkspace
data.value: {manager} workspace of {count, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}}
data.comment: Beside a Node workspace's folder: its package manager and how many packages it holds.

data.name: NamedPackage
data.comment: Beside a Node package's folder whose package's name is another; {kind} is its package manager, or its workspace.

data.name: PackageTip
data.comment: The tip of a Node package's folder; {source} says what named its package manager, {runs} its scripts.

data.name: NoScripts
data.comment: A Node package's tip where it has no scripts.

data.name: ScriptsRun
data.value: {count, plural, one {its script {scripts} runs} other {its scripts {scripts} run}} from the run configurations
data.comment: A Node package's tip: the scripts it runs from the run configurations, listed.

data.name: ReferencesThis
data.comment: Beside a project Add Reference cannot offer, as it references the project already; {where} is where it is.

data.name: ReferencedBy
data.comment: Add Reference's heading; {project} is the project's name.

data.name: NestSameNames
data.value: Show files with the same names as nested
data.comment: File Nesting's check box nesting files by their names.

data.name: ParentSuffix
data.comment: The heading of File Nesting's column of the suffixes of files others nest under.

data.name: ChildSuffix
data.comment: The heading of File Nesting's column of the suffixes of files that nest under them.

data.name: NestingRules
data.comment: The heading over File Nesting's rules.

data.name: DockerfileHad
data.comment: Add Docker Support's first choice where the project has a Dockerfile.

data.name: DockerfileBeside
data.value: A Dockerfile beside the project, and a .dockerignore at the solution's folder
data.comment: Add Docker Support's first choice.

data.name: SdkContainer
data.value: The .NET SDK's container support: dotnet publish /t:{target} builds the image, with no Dockerfile
data.comment: Add Docker Support's second choice; {target} is the SDK's publish target.

data.name: ImageBuilt
data.comment: Add Docker Support's heading.

data.name: ComposeServices
data.comment: Add Docker Compose's heading over the projects it runs.

data.name: BesidePackages
data.comment: Add Docker Compose's heading over the databases, caches and brokers their packages point to.

data.name: NoBacking
data.value: No database, cache or broker among their packages
data.comment: Add Docker Compose where the projects' packages point to no database, cache or broker.
